name: Cedar Street Studio
description: A neighbourhood studio for thoughtful repairs and handmade furniture.

pages.title: Made to last
pages.body: Welcome to Cedar Street Studio. We repair well-loved furniture and build practical pieces for everyday life.

pages.title: Our studio
pages.body: We are a small independent workshop. Every project begins with a conversation about what you need and what is worth preserving.

pages.title: Repairs and commissions
pages.body:
Furniture repairs
Small custom furniture
Finishing and restoration
Contact us with a description of your project to arrange an estimate.

pages.title: Visit the workshop
pages.body:
Monday to Friday: 9 am to 5 pm
Saturday: by appointment
Sunday: closed

pages.title: Start a conversation
pages.body: Tell us about your project using the contact form. Include the kind of piece, the work needed, and when you hope to have it ready.
